review: The bed was exceptionally comfortable and the room was spotless, but the breakfast buffet was cold and disappointing.
Front desk staff were warm, welcoming, and assisted with luggage immediately. However, the air conditioning made loud rattling noises all night.
Outstanding location right next to the metro station and within walking distance of all major monuments.
Extremely overpriced for the quality provided. The bathroom was cramped, water pressure was weak, and Wi-Fi kept dropping every ten minutes.
We had a peaceful and quiet stay with soundproof windows overlooking the courtyard. The concierge recommended wonderful local restaurants.
The housekeeping team was friendly and attentive, replenishing towels every morning. Unfortunately, the pool was closed for maintenance during our entire weekend.
The dinner at the rooftop restaurant was fantastic with delicious pasta and great wine, though the wait time for a table was about 45 minutes.
Dirty carpets in the hallway and a strange musty smell in the bathroom. Definitely not worth the high rate.
Spacious modern suite with a panoramic skyline view. The gym was well-equipped with clean machines and free bottled water.
Great value for money! Affordable rates, spotless rooms, and super polite receptionists made our family trip memorable.
The street noise was unbearable until 2 AM despite having the balcony doors shut. The reception offered earplugs but could not change our room.
Breakfast was average, with basic toast, eggs, and coffee. Nothing special, but acceptable for a quick morning bite.
Valet parking was smooth and quick. The elevator was fast and the overall ambiance of the lobby felt very luxurious.
Worst experience ever. The bed sheets were stained, the shower had no hot water, and the manager was rude when we complained.
Centrally located hotel in a vibrant neighborhood with plenty of cafes and shops nearby. Room was compact but cozy and clean.
